segments.text: That Chriſt Jeſus by his death did bring forth ſalvation and reconciliation onely for the elect, which were thoſe which God the Father gave him; & that the Goſpel which is to be preached to all men as the ground of faith, is, that Ieſus is the Chriſt, the Sonne of the ever-bleſſed God, filled with the perfection of all heavenly and ſpirituall excellencies, and that ſalvation is onely and alone to be had through the beleeving in his Name.
